key.name: accounts
key.summary: Accounts in top-bar order
key.description: Names of the account-N children in use. Other names are ignored.

key.name: grace-period
key.summary: Grace period in seconds
key.description: Keep the last successful reading without a warning during temporary failures. Starts at the first failed refresh, or when the retry delay that failure asked for ends; zero marks retained readings stale from then on.

key.name: panel-box
key.summary: Top-bar area of the indicators

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Position of the first indicator in its top-bar area
key.description: Counts every item of the area, including those of GNOME Shell and other extensions. Positions past the last item place the indicators at the end.

key.name: panel-label
key.summary: Top-bar label template
key.description: Placeholders: {percent}, {remaining}, {used}, {reset}, {reset_time}, {window} and {account}. Empty hides the label.

key.name: show-used
key.summary: Show used instead of remaining percentages

key.name: show-reset-clock
key.summary: Show the clock time of resets in the menu

key.name: show-history
key.summary: Record usage history and show it in the menu

key.name: notify-low-remaining
key.summary: Notify when the usage shown in the top bar runs low
key.description: Each indicator notifies at most once per usage window. The first reading after enabling the extension or changing the account or shown window does not notify.

key.name: low-remaining-threshold
key.summary: Remaining percentage that triggers the notification

key.name: notify-unused
key.summary: Notify when usage would go unused before a reset

key.name: unused-threshold
key.summary: Projected percentage left at the reset that triggers the reminder

key.name: unused-hours
key.summary: Hours before the reset when the reminder may appear

key.name: notify-reset-expiry
key.summary: Notify when a Codex manual reset expires within 48 hours

key.name: toggle-agent-usage-menu
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens the first account's menu

key.name: show-logo
key.summary: Show each provider's logo in the top bar

key.name: show-bar
key.summary: Show the remaining limit as a level bar

key.name: show-dots
key.summary: Show the remaining limit as level dots

key.name: level-bar-position
key.summary: Position of the level bar relative to the logo
key.description: 0 places the bar on the left, 1 on the right, and 2 below the logo.

key.name: indicator-size
key.summary: Logo size when a level indicator appears below it
key.description: Percentage of the available logo area used by the logo.

key.name: color-scheme
key.summary: Color scheme for the level bar and dots
key.description: 0 uses symbolic colors, 1 uses status colors, and 2 uses custom colors.

key.name: custom-colors
key.summary: Custom colors for each 10 percent range
key.description: Colors run from 0–10 percent through 91–100 percent remaining.
